app.title: Chimera Vocal Synth
app.description: A web-based vocal synthesizer that generates singing audio from text prompts using a neural vocoder.
proposed_tests: input sample text and select voice
trigger synthesis and verify audio file is returned
measure latency from input to audio playback
attempt multiple concurrent synth requests to test concurrency limits
